title: Delivery drivers will get minimum wage in Australia’s ‘world-first’ deal. Is it fair – and will Uber Eats cost more?

paragraphs.en: From Monday, an Uber or Doordash delivery driver in Australia will earn at least $31.30 an hour – a milestone for gig economy workers who have struggled with low pay and lack of protections for over a decade.
paragraphs.zh: 从周一开始，澳大利亚的优步（Uber）或DoorDash配送司机每小时至少可赚31.30美元——这对十多年来一直饱受低薪和缺乏保护之苦的零工经济从业者而言，是一个里程碑。

paragraphs.en: The union hailed its deal with DoorDash and Uber Eats – the two organisations that control most of Australia’s food delivery market – as a “world first”.
paragraphs.zh: 工会将其与DoorDash和优步外卖（Uber Eats）——这两家控制着澳大利亚大部分外卖市场的公司——达成的协议誉为“世界首创”。

paragraphs.en: Considering Australia’s industrial umpire, the Fair Work Commission, pretty much stuck to the proposed conditions it was handed, are gig economy workers really going to get a better deal? And is the price of your takeaway food about to go up?
paragraphs.zh: 鉴于澳大利亚的劳资仲裁机构公平工作委员会（Fair Work Commission）基本坚持了向其提交的拟议条款，零工经济从业者真的能获得更好的待遇吗？你的外卖价格又要上涨了吗？

paragraphs.en: The new minimum standards applies to any gig worker that performs on-demand delivery of food, drinks, or groceries .
paragraphs.zh: 新的最低标准适用于任何从事按需配送食品、饮料或日用杂货的零工从业者。

paragraphs.en: The standards include new dispute processes, new feedback mechanisms, representation rights and personal injury insurance for injured workers.
paragraphs.zh: 这些标准包括新的争议解决程序、新的反馈机制、代表权，以及为受伤工人提供的个人伤害保险。

paragraphs.en: Related: Delivery drivers to be paid minimum $31.30 an hour across Australia in ‘world-leading’ decision
paragraphs.zh: 相关阅读：澳大利亚全国配送司机每小时最低工资31.30美元，“世界领先”的裁定

paragraphs.en: The headline item is arguably the “safety net” minimum pay rates for gig workers, who will initially receive hourly rates ranging from $31.30 – for bike riders – to $32 for those driving a car.
paragraphs.zh: 其中最受关注的项目，可以说是为零工从业者设立的“安全网”最低工资标准：起初，骑自行车配送者每小时最低工资为31.30美元，开汽车配送者为32美元。

paragraphs.en: The minimum rates will increase by 50 cents an hour from 1 January 2027.
paragraphs.zh: 自2027年1月1日起，最低时薪将上调50美分。
